Changelog

Source: CHANGELOG.md

The changelog for this project is NEWS.md.

R packages record their release history in NEWS.md: it is what utils::news() parses, what pkgdown renders as the Changelog tab, and what CRAN and R CMD check expect. This file exists because “CHANGELOG.md” is where people coming from other ecosystems look first.

It deliberately does not restate the entries. A second hand-maintained copy of the same history is a second thing to forget to update, and a changelog that disagrees with itself is worse than one that lives in a single place — the same reason this codebase refuses silently divergent scientific keys.

If you are looking for:

you want read
what changed, by version NEWS.md
how to cite this work CITATION.cff / CITATION.bib
where every figure came from docs/FIGURE_PROVENANCE.md
where every data input came from docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md
what the method does and why vignette("e2sfca-accessibility")
